steps.fact: The left referent is billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC.
Contract MSA-MER-2024 names Meridian Energy Partners LLC as its Counterparty.
Billing records show billed_name Meridian Energy Partners LLC.
Commercial notes state that Meridian Energy Partners invoices are the advisory retainer under MSA-MER-2024.

The packet provides no legal identifier shared across both referents, no explicit identity mapping between billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC and contract:MSA-MER-2024, and no statement licensing identifier or name uniqueness.
Shared naming and operational association are compatibility evidence only; they do not meet the burden to establish identity between the two referents.

support_claim: The packet associates the same trade name with billing and with contract MSA-MER-2024, but provides no establishing identity evidence such as a shared legal identifier or an explicit referent mapping, so the identity burden for SAME_ENTITY is not met and no distinctness evidence supports DISTINCT.
